rules.instructions: Trace inputs, callers, error paths, and tests. Identify a concrete trigger and observable impact. Passing analyzers do not establish correctness.

source.attribution: Google Engineering Practices, summarized for this auditor

rules.instructions: Identify unnecessary complexity only when a concrete maintenance failure or costly task follows from it. Project architecture and style decisions take precedence for preferences.

source.attribution: Google Engineering Practices, summarized for this auditor

rules.instructions: Trace simultaneous operations and resource lifecycles. Report a concrete interleaving, ownership mistake, or unreleased resource with an observable consequence. Do not assert a race from shared state alone.

source.attribution: Google Engineering Practices, summarized for this auditor

rules.instructions: Compare interacting components with the documented project boundaries. Identify a concrete dependency or contract mismatch and its operational or maintenance impact. Project architecture preferences take precedence for discretionary design choices.

source.attribution: Google Engineering Practices, summarized for this auditor

rules.instructions: Compare important behavior and edge cases with the actual assertions and fixtures. Missing tests require a concrete uncovered behavior and next test, rather than a general demand for more coverage.
required_evidence: relevant test location or concrete missing case

source.attribution: Google Engineering Practices, summarized for this auditor

rules.instructions: Trace external or less trusted data across a concrete trust boundary. Check the receiving operation validates required types, bounds, and semantic constraints. Claim a security problem only with a concrete input path, failure mechanism, and privilege or resource impact. Input validation does not replace authorization, parameterized commands, or context-aware output encoding.
